include(ExternalProject)

set(MOSQUITTO_INSTALL_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/install)
set(MOSQUITTO_INSTALL_DIR ${MOSQUITTO_INSTALL_DIR} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(MOSQUITTO_INCLUDE_DIR ${MOSQUITTO_INSTALL_DIR}/include)
set(MOSQUITTO_INCLUDE_DIR ${MOSQUITTO_INCLUDE_DIR} PARENT_SCOPE)

file(GLOB PATCH_FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/patches/*.patch")
set(PATCH_COMMANDS "")
foreach(PATCH_FILE ${PATCH_FILES})
  list(
    APPEND
    PATCH_COMMANDS
    patch -Np1 -i ${PATCH_FILE}
  )
endforeach()

ExternalProject_Add(
  mosquitto-project
  URL ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../libs/mosquitto
  PATCH_COMMAND ${PATCH_COMMANDS}
  CMAKE_ARGS
    -DWITH_STATIC_LIBRARIES=ON
    -DWITH_PIC=ON
    -DWITH_THREADING=OFF
    -DWITH_CJSON=OFF
    -DWITH_CLIENTS=OFF
    -DWITH_BROKER=OFF
    -DWITH_APPS=OFF
    -DWITH_PLUGINS=OFF
    -DDOCUMENTATION=OFF
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${MOSQUITTO_INSTALL_DIR}
    -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${OPENSSL_INSTALL_DIR}/lib/cmake
    -DOPENSSL_USE_STATIC_LIBS=ON
  INSTALL_DIR "${MOSQUITTO_INSTALL_DIR}"
)

add_dependencies(mosquitto-project OpenSSL)

# The include dir must exist at configure time
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${MOSQUITTO_INCLUDE_DIR})

if(MSVC)
  set(MOSQUITTO_LIBRARY_PATH ${MOSQUITTO_INSTALL_DIR}/lib/mosquitto_static.lib)
else()
  set(MOSQUITTO_LIBRARY_PATH ${MOSQUITTO_INSTALL_DIR}/lib/libmosquitto_static.a)
endif()

add_library(libmosquitto STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
add_dependencies(libmosquitto mosquitto-project)
set_target_properties(
  libmosquitto
  PROPERTIES
  IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_LANGUAGES "C"
  IMPORTED_LOCATION ${MOSQUITTO_LIBRARY_PATH}
  INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${MOSQUITTO_INCLUDE_DIR}
  INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS LIBMOSQUITTO_STATIC
)

target_link_libraries(libmosquitto INTERFACE OpenSSL::SSL)
